title: The localization short exact sequence of ordinary strict systems
statement: Let i:Z↪T be a closed immersion, U its complementary quasi-compact open immersion regarded as an object of T_proet, and B an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves. Supply K:ClosedData(i,B) [def-sp-semilinear-open-closed-data] and an ordinary open datum O [def-pur-sequence-site-open-data]. For every ordinary strict B-system M [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], the actual open counit O.Jfun(O.L(M))→M is monic, the actual closed unit M→push(pull(M)) is epic, and the pair is exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. No complex or coefficient-change comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Evaluate at n. The open datum level and restrictionLevel comparisons and its counit_level equation identify the first arrow with ordinary open extension counit. The closed datum pushEvaluation, pullEvaluation and unitEvaluation identify the second with the level unit. Use levelPresentation and uniqueness of left adjoints to transport it to the small-model ringed inverse-image adjunction.

Apply the ringed pro-etale localization theorem at the ring sheaf B_n with the given closed immersion and its quasi-compact complementary open. It gives monicity of the first map, epicity of the second and exactness. Transport these properties through the preceding comparisons.

Evaluation is exact. It is jointly conservative since componentwise inverses of invertible system maps commute with all transitions. It therefore detects zero objects and, by kernels/cokernels/homology, monicity, epicity and exactness. The composite is zero because every evaluated component is zero. Thus the ordinary system pair is short exact.

theorem semilinearOrdinaryLocalization
    {T Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : T.ProEt) [IsOpenImmersion U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom]
    (hU : Set.range U.hom = (Set.range i)ᶜ)
    (B : ℕ → Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n) (K : ClosedData i B τ)
    (O : SequenceOpenOrdinary.{u + 1, u, 0} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) U B τ)
    (M : Systems.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) B τ) :
    Mono (O.adjunction.counit.app M) ∧ Epi ((adjunction i B τ).unit.app M) ∧
      (ComposableArrows.mk₂ (O.adjunction.counit.app M)
        ((adjunction i B τ).unit.app M)).Exact
